Chou Kuukan Nighter Pro Yakyuu King 2.name: Chou Kuukan Nighter: King of Pro Baseball 2
Chou Kuukan Nighter Pro Yakyuu King 2.summary: Chou Kuukan Nighter: King of Pro Baseball 2 is a Sports game, developed by Genki and published by Imagineer, which was released in Japan in 1999.

Mickey's Speedway USA.name: Mickey's Speedway USA
Mickey's Speedway USA.summary: Buckle up and get ready to race! Rally across America with Mickey and friends! Race around 20 All-American courses - from Alaska to the Everglades - as you try to track down the Weasels and rescue poor dognapped Pluto. Use Ludwig Von Drake's wacky weapons - such as the "Antigrav-o-Kit Magno Flyer" or the "Stormy Weather Whenever Engager" - to give you the edge. Then blast past your friends and listen as the drivers taunt each other using Disney's original character voices!

Pyoro 64.name: Pyoro 64
Pyoro 64.summary:
Pyoro 64 is a homebrew game for the Nintendo 64 based off of the Pyoro and Pyoro 2 minigames for WarioWare, Inc. for the Game Boy Advance.
The player controls a bird which needs to eat the beans with its elongated tongue, before they fall on the ground.
